snippet.title: Welcome to Covenant Cards | Official Cinematic Intro
snippet.description:
Step into a world where ancient miracles and modern warfare collide. Welcome to the official cinematic prologue of Covenant Cards.

Before you build your deck, before you draw your first hand, listen to the lore that shaped this multiverse. You are the tactician. The eras are yours to command. Are you ready to forge your covenant?

⚔️ The battle begins now. Download and play for free:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759227375
